description: This file defines the AgentService class which is the core component of a ReAct agent implementation in Flutter. It manages the agent's interaction loop, integrates with different chat services (mock or OpenAI), handles tools for file operations, time retrieval, and calculations, and processes agent steps and errors.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent-related errors, encapsulates error type and optional detail message.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class implementing the ReAct agent loop, managing tools, message history, and interaction with chat services.

classes.name: _TI
classes.description: Helper class for token iteration during expression evaluation.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's state, including steps, messages, and running status.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the agent's reasoning and action loop based on user input, updating internal steps and messages.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's step list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the available tools the agent can utilize, such as file reading/writing, time, and calculation.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes a tool action command, returning the result as a string.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses the action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses argument string into a list of argument values.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content enclosed within specific XML tags from a text.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the system prompt guiding the agent's reasoning process, listing available tools.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string to a double value.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes an expression string into operators and operands.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction in the expression tokens.

methods.name: _pT
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division in the expression tokens.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors, handling parentheses and unary minus.
